req.title: Player update persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall write updates to the players table so subsequent GET calls reflect the modification.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that updates to a player should persist in the database and be reflected in subsequent GET requests. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful updates, a negative test to handle mismatched squad numbers, and a boundary test to ensure updates at the edge of valid squad numbers are handled correctly.

tests.name: test_update_player_success
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to update player with squad number 10.
expected: Subsequent GET request returns updated player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Update player with squad number 10
update_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Inter Miami",
    "league": "MLS",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify the update with a GET request
response = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
assert response.status_code == 200
player = response.json()
assert player["team"] == "Inter Miami"
assert player["league"] == "MLS"

tests.name: test_update_player_mismatched_squad_number
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to update player with mismatched squad number in body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update player with mismatched squad number
update_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 11,  # Mismatched squad number
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Inter Miami",
    "league": "MLS",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_update_player_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to update player with squad number 1.
expected: Subsequent GET request returns updated player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Update player with squad number 1 (boundary case)
update_data = {
    "firstName": "Franco",
    "middleName": "Daniel",
    "lastName": "Armani",
    "dateOfBirth": "1986-10-16T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Copa de la Liga",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify the update with a GET request
response = client.get("/players/squadnumber/1")
assert response.status_code == 200
player = response.json()
assert player["starting11"] is True
